Rockstar Games has created the greatest game of all time.

You could show these GTA 6 gameplay clips to someone who knows nothing about the game, and they would genuinely believe they’re watching real-life footage.

Gaming World is hosting a free midnight launch event for GTA 6 at Grails, Miami on November 18.

- Recreates the iconic midnight launch experience everyone is missing
- Gameplay stations and creators appearances
- Exclusive collectibles and merch
- Game codes and HyperX giveaways

📦 Elle serait accompagnée d'un fourreau de protection, et tout semble soigneusement rangé à l'intérieur !

👀 Vous en pensez quoi ? Vous aimeriez mettre
